story.summary: A judge in New Mexico has ordered Meta to pay $25 billion to the state after a jury found last month that the social media giant had deceived users in a case related to the Cambridge Analytica scandal. Meta ordered to pay New Mexico $25 billion for deceiving users about privacy on Facebook - AP News.
